//: Explicit builds rather than zero-config detection.
Zero-config treated files under src/ as additional serverless entrypoints,
which fails because they export named helpers (buildApp) rather than a
default handler:  Invalid export found in module '/var/task/src/app.js'.
Declaring the build pins exactly one function; everything under src/ is
bundled as an ordinary dependency of it.
public/ is served by Vercel's CDN as static assets rather than through the
function. That is faster (no lambda invocation for the dashboard), and it
avoids @fastify/static having to resolve a directory inside the bundle.
The API and the Vapi webhook are the only things that need the function.
Route order matters: the explicit static paths are matched before the
catch-all that forwards everything else to Fastify.
